name: latent
description: Strava for deep work: battery-friendly timelapses of your focus sessions

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
